summary: End-to-end tested the AI Automation Engine sprint. 19/19 backend pytest tests pass covering defaults (enabled+prepare), 12 template seed, approvals seed, approve/reject/edit/prepare, safety downgrade (external/generative in auto mode -> pending, not executed), safe internal auto (create_task auto-executes), master pause/resume + disable, per-automation toggle, builder CRUD with validation, logs with event_label, run-now, org isolation (cross-tenant approve returns 404), and regression on /api/memory/stats, /api/opportunities, /api/crm/sales-metrics, /api/assistant/suggestions. Frontend E2E passes: demo login -> dashboard widget renders, sidebar nav-automations -> /automations shows status strip, 4 tabs, 12 automation cards each with toggle/mode/delete, 5 seeded approval cards with approve/reject/disable/risk (email approvals with edit/save), Approve removes card, builder dialog opens with trigger/mode/save controls, Run now works (toast 'Scan complete'), Pause dropdown exposes 1h/tomorrow/1w/forever, Settings tab has all switches. Everything functional.

minor_testid_mismatches.issue: Add condition button uses data-testid='builder-add-condition' while spec calls it 'add-condition'. Functional; consider renaming for spec parity.

action_items: Optional: rename data-testid 'builder-add-condition' -> 'add-condition' for spec parity.
critical_code_review_comments: _evaluate() accepts a `force` argument that is never used (still works because POST /run bypasses _maybe_evaluate throttle by calling _evaluate directly). Cosmetic; remove or wire it in.

prepare_email/prepare_followup on approve: the code path does `pass` in _execute_one — status flips to 'executed' but nothing tangibly marks the email as 'ready to send' beyond the approval status. Consider stamping the approval doc/action with a 'ready_to_send: true' marker for clarity (per user choice 2a).
Time-saved counter only increments on auto-execute and manual approve — rejects/edits leave time_saved alone (correct).
Files are within acceptable size (routers/automation.py 1055 lines) but could be split into engine/api modules for maintainability.
test_credentials: Demo flow only. POST /api/auth/demo (backend) / data-testid='explore-demo-btn' on /login (UI). Fresh isolated tenant each call.
seed_data_creation: Each demo login seeds 12 template automations + ~5 pending approvals (3 new_client + 1 lead_needs_followup + 1 client_inactive) automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Automation engine backend is stable. Demo tenant seeds produce matches only for triggers new_client / lead_needs_followup / client_inactive because there are no seeded proposals/invoices/contracts. If future tests need to exercise proposal_/invoice_/contract_ triggers directly, seed those docs first or manually POST them. THROTTLE_SECONDS=120 — use POST /api/automation/run to force evaluation in tests.
